day_shape: 54 items: Iran's rial hits record lows with euro past 3m rials and Central Bank announcing $10,000 retail sales, IDF strikes targeted Hamas Gaza leader Ali al-Amoudi and killed two PIJ commanders, UK charges two Iranians over alleged London bomb plot, heavy Khamenei/IRGC 'Janfada' mobilisation messaging.

threads.label: Rial collapse and Central Bank response
threads.summary: Iran International reported the euro crossed 3 million rials and the dollar neared 2.7 million on Saturday as the rial hit fresh lows. IRIB carried statements from Central Bank deputy Darabi attributing the rise to speculation and delayed export-currency returns, announcing retail dollar sales of up to $10,000 per adult at participating banks.

threads.label: IDF strikes on Hamas and PIJ in Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF said two Palestinian Islamic Jihad commanders — Ahmed Mahmoud Harb Ramlawi and Munir Ibrahim Masri — were killed in separate Gaza City strikes. A separate overnight airstrike in western Gaza City targeted Ali al-Amoudi, described as Yahya Sinwar's successor as Hamas's Gaza leader, with Palestinian media reporting five killed.

threads.label: UK Iranian terror plot cases
threads.summary: Two Iranian nationals appeared in a London court charged with plotting a homemade-bomb attack on the Jewish community. Separately, a dual UK-Iranian national arrested over the suspected RAF Fairford bomb plot was released on bail.

threads.label: Janfada mobilisation and IRGC messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported the opening of a second Janfada military and rescue training centre and a Tehran base in Haft Teri Square, with Basij deputy Kousari saying a thousand battalions have been prepared across six training modules. IRGC Aerospace adviser Balali claimed the weapons production supply chain is intact.

threads.label: Executions, repression and dissent
threads.summary: Iran International and the Jerusalem Post reported the execution of Siavash Jamshidi Kheirabadi, arrested during January's Shahrekord protests, announced by the judiciary's Mizan agency. Iran International also reported senior officials photographed wearing smartwatches drawing criticism over security discipline, and an MP's health committee warning that patients are selling possessions to pay for care.

events.title_en: Continued advances of Yemen's army; Taiz on the verge of liberation
events.summary_en: The director of Al-Mayadeen network's office in Yemen announced that based on available information, Yemen's armed forces may gain control of the strategic area of Tarib in Taiz province within the coming hours or days. He also reported widespread looting of a number of military bases in Ash-Shamaitain city and the flight of military commanders loyal to Saudi Arabia, stating that these developments have occurred as Yemen's armed forces have moved closer to Tarib. The director of Al-Mayadeen's office in Yemen emphasised that control of Tarib can create conditions for achieving fire superiority and ensuring security in other areas of Taiz province.

events.title_en: National Interest wrote about Iran's increased cyber capabilities against America
events.summary_en: The American magazine National Interest reported that Iran has developed its cyber capabilities in recent years and now has the ability to target critical infrastructure, such as water and electricity systems in America and Europe. This report was published about a month after cyber attacks on water and wastewater systems in 12 US states; attacks that US officials and reports have attributed to Iran and claimed that certain remote control capabilities and water pressure control systems were disrupted in these operations.

events.summary_en: The chief of the general staff of the armed forces and commander of the central headquarters of Imam Khomeini sent a congratulatory message on the occasion of the achievements of Iranian athletes in the Nagoya Asian Games 2026. The brilliance and achievements of the honourable and worthy athletes of the Islamic Republic of Iran in the Nagoya Asian Games 2026 demonstrated a valuable manifestation of the capability, will, diligence and spirit of valour of the youth of Islamic Iran. I congratulate this valuable success to the noble nation of Iran, especially to the champion youth and medal winners, coaches and technical staff, their esteemed families, and the sports community of the country.
